{"notes": "VISIT 6 (8:15-9:00). Table: all dominoes dark and on-chain, nose, top arc, body, belly, forked tail and tail loop all intact; no pale pieces, no stray curl. Still never saw anyone's hands, so all credit rests on self-reports and cross-checks. Team hands-off since 6:45.

Priya: Publicly and privately reported full connection (161 standing). Privately repeated that the curl was her overreach and that Maya cleaned it up, which is consistent and honest. Claims belly and nose bridge, still overlapping Maya's belly claim. Credits Leo for coordinating, Tom for the fork fix. Kept time and hands-off discipline (called the one-minute warning). Good communication; early curl cost her.

Maya: Privately said she took the belly and cleared the curl. Consistent with Priya's account of the cleanup. Belly overlap with Priya remains unresolved; ask who built which section. Solid attention to final look, but quiet publicly this visit.

Tom: Privately claims he fixed the lower fork handoff at the tail; Priya independently confirms it, and the tail is connected. Best corroborated tail contribution. Also spoke publicly, reinforcing hands-off. Ask which dominoes he placed.

Leo: Silent this visit, said nothing to me. Priya credits him with coordinating body and tail, but no one else does and I saw no physical output. Cannot yet credit him on execution; ask what he built and whether his final nose and tail check happened.

Review: Ask each who built or fixed what; resolve the belly overlap between Priya and Maya. Don't rate on the final result alone. Leo is the biggest evidence gap."}
